name: c-trace-6
title: Answer with citations
description: Numbered citations in a research answer open the sources and move focus to the cited source.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Badge } from "@/components/reui/badge" import { cn } from "cn" import { Trace, TraceCollapsible, TraceCollapsibleContent, TraceCollapsibleTrigger, TraceDescription, TraceIcon, TraceLine, TraceTitle, } from "@/components/ui/trace" import { IconPlaceholder } from "@/app/(create)/components/icon-placeholder" type Source = { id: number; title: string; domain: string; href: string } const QUERIES = [ { query: "localStorage session token xss risk", results: 8 }, { query: "httponly cookie spa refresh token", results: 6 }, ] const SOURCES: Source[] = [ { id: 1, title: "Session management cheat sheet", domain: "owasp.org", href: "#", }, { id: 2, title: "Window: localStorage property", domain: "developer.mozilla.org", href: "#", }, { id: 3, title: "Set-Cookie header", domain: "developer.mozilla.org", href: "#", }, { id: 4, title: "OAuth 2.0 for browser-based apps", domain: "datatracker.ietf.org", href: "#", }, ] // A citation opens the sources and moves focus to the row it cites. export function Pattern() { const [sourcesOpen, setSourcesOpen] = React.useState(false) const [cited, setCited] = React.useState(null) const linkRefs = React.useRef(new Map()) // The panel mounts its rows only once it is open, so focus waits a frame. function showSource(id: number) { setSourcesOpen(true) setCited(id) window.requestAnimationFrame(() => linkRefs.current.get(id)?.focus()) } return (
Searched the web {QUERIES.length} times {QUERIES.map((item) => ( {item.query} {item.results} results ))} Read {SOURCES.length} sources {SOURCES.map((source) => ( { if (node) linkRefs.current.set(source.id, node) else linkRefs.current.delete(source.id) }} href={source.href} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" onBlur={() => setCited(null)} > {/* The cited source keeps full contrast until focus leaves it, so a mouse click shows where it landed. */} {source.id}. {source.title} (opens in a new tab) {source.domain} ))}
